sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def wbb():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    W=[n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color']=='W' and n['pixels']>50][0]
    rs=[p[0] for p in W['boundary']];cs=[p[1] for p in W['boundary']]
    return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
for i in range(6):
    action(['RIGHT'])
    print(i+1,"R",wbb(),"lvl",last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done'): break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
